coverage.excluded_results: Table 1/2 diagonals, Table 3 Ensemble rows and dashed ensemble curves are white-box results, retained only as context. Figures 1 and 3 are example visualizations; Figure 2 is an algorithm relationship diagram. Table 4 MI-FGSM* is an externally reported competition reference, not an original experiment. Table 4 averages are summaries, not additional independent rates.

result_groups.evidence: Joint clean correctness is explicit in Section 4.1. Testing generated examples does not explicitly resolve whether transfer denominators exclude source failures; diagonal success below 100% is not proof of the off-diagonal denominator.

result_groups.population: Separate 1,000 correctly classified images; model-specific extent of that phrase is not restated
result_groups.evidence: The frozen rule accepts correctly-classified-images wording; model coverage is recorded as unspecified rather than upgrading it to an independently verified joint filter. No explicit source-failure retention or exclusion rule found.

result_groups.locator: Sections 4.3-4.4, Table 3 Hold-out rows and Figures 4-6 solid curves, PDF pp. 5-7
result_groups.population: Section 4.1 jointly correct seven-network cohort; six-model source ensembles with one hold-out target
result_groups.evidence: Shared experimental setup supplies the clean filter. No explicit denominator conditioned on success of the source ensemble is given; white-box rates are reported separately.

result_groups.locator: Section 4.5 and Table 4 original attack rows, PDF pp. 7-8
result_groups.population: Separately described 5,000-image competition-style set; eight-model source ensemble and six defense/baseline evaluations
result_groups.evidence: This section introduces additional defenses and a separate dataset description without an explicit clean-correct filter covering those defenses. Extending the Section 4.1 seven-network filter to all Table 4 defenses would require an assumption. Source-success conditioning is also unresolved.

f1.evidence: The joint-correct selection establishes correctness for the initial seven-model cohort but does not provide complete separate clean measurements for the added competition defenses/source ensemble. No explicit pooled-only reporting statement supports no.

f2.evidence: Three result groups have affirmative filtering evidence under the frozen rule; the competition group remains unresolved. Preserve any_explicit_yes=true rather than describing the whole paper as lacking clean filtering.

f3.evidence: Source success rates and target success rates are reported, but no reviewed passage explicitly defines retention or exclusion of source failures in transfer denominators. Do not infer no from the tables.

f4.evidence: Table 1's 23.5% on a nominal 5,000 inputs admits counts 1,173 through 1,177 under nearest-tenth rounding even before denominator uncertainty. One-decimal percentages on 1,000 could uniquely recover counts only with confirmed denominator and aggregation. Graphs and defense averages do not supply exact counts for every result; no explicit paper-wide percentages-only statement warrants no.

f5.evidence: Gradient-sign experiments specify L-infinity radius 15 in pixel units; competition experiments give per-batch radii 4/255,8/255,12/255,16/255. The C&W paragraph specifies optimizer iterations, learning rate and confidence, but does not clearly establish a numerical L2/L-infinity radius for Table 2. Do not silently apply the gradient-sign radius to C&W or infer an explicit unbounded attack.

f6.locator: Released README and attack.py at 10ffd9b9e94585b6a3b9d6858a9a929dc488fc02; main Section 4.1 model links
f6.evidence: The accessible release provides a sample Inception-v3 generator and source checkpoint link, but the inspected files do not establish a complete original source-target evaluation path, selected example IDs or per-example clean/attacked outcomes. Public model references remain candidates, not verified sufficiency. No runtime was executed in this review.

artifact_checks.result: Read complete README and attack.py; remote HEAD matches local commit 10ffd9b9e94585b6a3b9d6858a9a929dc488fc02. Root inventory contains attack.py, README, LICENSE and two illustrations; no released evaluation script or prediction record in that inventory. This bounded inspection is not a claim about every historical branch or downstream implementation.
Source checkpoint URL identified in README; download/runtime compatibility and target checkpoint alignment were not verified. It cannot alone establish transfer recomputability.

Static reconciliation: line 45 defaults max_epsilon=16, whereas the main fixed-budget experiment specifies 15. stop() takes int(min(epsilon+4,1.25*epsilon)), yielding 18 at epsilon=15. graph() sets the attack label from the first prediction after input_diversity(x), not necessarily the untransformed clean prediction or supplied ground truth. main() saves PNGs but does not compute the source/target conditioning counts. These are demo properties, not evidence of settings used for published tables.

bounds_checks.reason: Target-clean error is zero by cohort selection; subtracting generic ImageNet clean error would be invalid. No positive baseline-error contribution is asserted. Source-success denominator remains unresolved, so no new unconditional-rate extraction is made.

The qualitative coding rule accepts correctly classified wording, but quantitative bounds additionally need unambiguous target/population alignment and denominator. Do not infer these from the paper-level yes shortcut.

No matched clean rate on this competition evaluation population was established for the added defense pipelines. Baselines with source-ensemble overlap must not be represented as wholly unseen targets. No numerical bounds added.

limitations: Complete denotes documented non-blind review of available material, not successful reconstruction or independent agreement.
The cached source is arXiv v4; a CVF availability listing was checked but publication-version numerical identity was not asserted.
No released artifact was executed and no historical first-pass CSV judgment was overwritten.
